children: deBridge is set to unlock at least 349.23 million DBR on 16 Jan 2027. The unlock covers tokens for the ecosystem, foundation and team. The announced amount equals 5.35% of the circulating supply.
The unlock lifts vesting restrictions that prevent these tokens from coming to market. Once those restrictions are removed, holders can put a substantially larger amount of DBR up for sale.

title: deBridge: Supply Unlock Releases at Least 349.23 Million DBR - 16 Jan 2027
